verses.original: Ἐρωτῶμεν δὲ ὑμᾶς ἀδελφοί ὑπὲρ τῆς παρουσίας τοῦ Κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ καὶ ἡμῶν ἐπισυναγωγῆς ἐπ’ αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: Erōtōmen de hymas adelphoi hyper tēs parousias tou Kyriou hēmōn Iēsou Christou kai hēmōn episynagōgēs ep’ auton
verses.literal: Now concerning the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ and our being gathered together to Him we ask you brothers

verses.original: εἰς τὸ μὴ ταχέως σαλευθῆναι ὑμᾶς ἀπὸ τοῦ νοὸς μηδὲ θροεῖσθαι μήτε διὰ πνεύματος μήτε διὰ λόγου μήτε δι’ ἐπιστολῆς ὡς δι’ ἡμῶν ὡς ὅτι ἐνέστηκεν ἡ ἡμέρα τοῦ Κυρίου
verses.transliteration: eis to mē tacheōs saleuthēnai hymas apo tou noos mēde throeisthai mēte dia pneumatos mēte dia logou mēte di’ epistolēs hōs di’ hēmōn hōs hoti enestēken hē hēmera tou Kyriou
verses.literal: not to be easily disconcerted . . . . . . . . . or alarmed by any spirit or message or letter seeming to be from us alleging that the Day of the Lord has already come

verses.original: μή τις ὑμᾶς ἐξαπατήσῃ κατὰ μηδένα τρόπον ὅτι ἐὰν μὴ ἔλθῃ ἡ ἀποστασία πρῶτον καὶ ἀποκαλυφθῇ ὁ ἄνθρωπος τῆς ἀνομίας ὁ υἱὸς τῆς ἀπωλείας
verses.transliteration: mē tis hymas exapatēsē kata mēdena tropon hoti ean mē elthē hē apostasia prōton kai apokalyphthē ho anthrōpos tēs anomias ho huios tēs apōleias
verses.literal: Let no one deceive you in any way for it will not come until . . . the rebellion occurs and the man of lawlessness the son of destruction is revealed

verses.original: ὁ ἀντικείμενος καὶ ὑπεραιρόμενος ἐπὶ πάντα λεγόμενον Θεὸν ἢ σέβασμα ὥστε αὐτὸν εἰς τὸν ναὸν τοῦ Θεοῦ καθίσαι ἀποδεικνύντα ἑαυτὸν ὅτι ἔστιν Θεός
verses.transliteration: ho antikeimenos kai hyperairomenos epi panta legomenon Theon ē sebasma hōste auton eis ton naon tou Theou kathisai apodeiknynta heauton hoti estin Theos
verses.literal: He will oppose and exalt himself above every so-called god or object of worship So he will seat himself in the temple of God proclaiming himself . . . to be God

verses.original: Οὐ μνημονεύετε ὅτι ἔτι ὢν πρὸς ὑμᾶς ταῦτα ἔλεγον ὑμῖν
verses.transliteration: Ou mnēmoneuete hoti eti ōn pros hymas tauta elegon hymin
verses.literal: Do you not remember that I told you these things while I was still with you

verses.original: καὶ νῦν τὸ κατέχον οἴδατε εἰς τὸ ἀποκαλυφθῆναι αὐτὸν ἐν τῷ ἑαυτοῦ καιρῷ
verses.transliteration: kai nyn to katechon oidate eis to apokalyphthēnai auton en tō heautou kairō
verses.literal: And you know what is now restraining him so that he may be revealed at the proper time

verses.original: τὸ γὰρ μυστήριον ἤδη ἐνεργεῖται τῆς ἀνομίας μόνον ὁ κατέχων ἄρτι ἕως ἐκ μέσου γένηται
verses.transliteration: to gar mystērion ēdē energeitai tēs anomias monon ho katechōn arti heōs ek mesou genētai
verses.literal: For the mystery of lawlessness is already at work but the one who now restrains it will continue until he is taken out of the way

verses.original: καὶ τότε ἀποκαλυφθήσεται ὁ ἄνομος ὃν ὁ Κύριος Ἰησοῦς ἀνελεῖ τῷ πνεύματι τοῦ στόματος αὐτοῦ καὶ καταργήσει τῇ ἐπιφανείᾳ τῆς παρουσίας αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: kai tote apokalyphthēsetai ho anomos hon ho Kyrios Iēsous anelei tō pneumati tou stomatos autou kai katargēsei tē epiphaneia tēs parousias autou
verses.literal: And then the lawless one will be revealed whom the Lord Jesus will slay with the breath of His mouth and annihilate by the majesty of His arrival

verses.original: οὗ ἐστιν ἡ παρουσία κατ’ ἐνέργειαν τοῦ Σατανᾶ ἐν πάσῃ δυνάμει καὶ σημείοις καὶ τέρασιν ψεύδους
verses.transliteration: hou estin hē parousia kat’ energeian tou Satana en pasē dynamei kai sēmeiois kai terasin pseudous
verses.literal: The coming of the lawless one will be accompanied by the working of Satan with every kind of power sign and false wonder

verses.original: καὶ ἐν πάσῃ ἀπάτῃ ἀδικίας τοῖς ἀπολλυμένοις ἀνθ’ ὧν τὴν ἀγάπην τῆς ἀληθείας οὐκ ἐδέξαντο εἰς τὸ σωθῆναι αὐτούς
verses.transliteration: kai en pasē apatē adikias tois apollymenois anth’ hōn tēn agapēn tēs alētheias ouk edexanto eis to sōthēnai autous
verses.literal: and with every wicked deception directed against those who are perishing because . . . they refused the love of the truth that would have saved them

verses.original: καὶ διὰ τοῦτο πέμπει αὐτοῖς ὁ Θεὸς ἐνέργειαν πλάνης εἰς τὸ πιστεῦσαι αὐτοὺς τῷ ψεύδει
verses.transliteration: kai dia touto pempei autois ho Theos energeian planēs eis to pisteusai autous tō pseudei
verses.literal: For this reason . . . God will send them a powerful delusion so that they believe the lie

verses.original: ἵνα κριθῶσιν πάντες οἱ μὴ πιστεύσαντες τῇ ἀληθείᾳ ἀλλὰ εὐδοκήσαντες τῇ ἀδικίᾳ
verses.transliteration: hina krithōsin pantes hoi mē pisteusantes tē alētheia alla eudokēsantes tē adikia
verses.literal: in order that judgment may come upon all who have disbelieved the truth and delighted in wickedness

verses.original: Ἡμεῖς δὲ ὀφείλομεν εὐχαριστεῖν τῷ Θεῷ πάντοτε περὶ ὑμῶν ἀδελφοὶ ἠγαπημένοι ὑπὸ Κυρίου ὅτι εἵλατο ὑμᾶς ὁ Θεὸς ἀπ᾽‿ ἀρχῆς εἰς σωτηρίαν ἐν ἁγιασμῷ Πνεύματος καὶ πίστει ἀληθείας
verses.transliteration: Hēmeis de opheilomen eucharistein tō Theō pantote peri hymōn adelphoi ēgapēmenoi hypo Kyriou hoti heilato hymas ho Theos ap᾽ archēs eis sōtērian en hagiasmō Pneumatos kai pistei alētheias
verses.literal: But we should always thank God for you brothers who are loved by the Lord because God chose you from the beginning to be saved by the sanctification of the Spirit and by faith in the truth

verses.original: εἰς ὃ καὶ ἐκάλεσεν ὑμᾶς διὰ τοῦ εὐαγγελίου ἡμῶν εἰς περιποίησιν δόξης τοῦ Κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ
verses.transliteration: eis ho kai ekalesen hymas dia tou euangeliou hēmōn eis peripoiēsin doxēs tou Kyriou hēmōn Iēsou Christou
verses.literal: To this He called you through our gospel so that you may share in the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ

verses.original: Ἄρα οὖν ἀδελφοί στήκετε καὶ κρατεῖτε τὰς παραδόσεις ἃς ἐδιδάχθητε εἴτε διὰ λόγου εἴτε δι’ ἐπιστολῆς ἡμῶν
verses.transliteration: Ara oun adelphoi stēkete kai krateite tas paradoseis has edidachthēte eite dia logou eite di’ epistolēs hēmōn
verses.literal: Therefore . . . brothers stand firm and cling to the traditions we taught you whether by speech or by letter

verses.original: Αὐτὸς δὲ ὁ Κύριος ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦς Χριστὸς καὶ ὁ Θεὸς ὁ Πατὴρ ἡμῶν ὁ ἀγαπήσας ἡμᾶς καὶ δοὺς παράκλησιν αἰωνίαν καὶ ἐλπίδα ἀγαθὴν ἐν χάριτι
verses.transliteration: Autos de ho Kyrios hēmōn Iēsous Christos kai ho Theos ho Patēr hēmōn ho agapēsas hēmas kai dous paraklēsin aiōnian kai elpida agathēn en chariti
verses.literal: Now may our Lord Jesus Christ Himself and God our Father who by grace has loved us and given us eternal comfort and good hope

verses.original: παρακαλέσαι ὑμῶν τὰς καρδίας καὶ στηρίξαι ἐν παντὶ ἔργῳ καὶ λόγῳ ἀγαθῷ
verses.transliteration: parakalesai hymōn tas kardias kai stērixai en panti ergō kai logō agathō
verses.literal: encourage your hearts and strengthen you in every good word and deed
